rows.label: Non-residents: taxation of income arising in Jordan and the 183-day test
rows.value: Any income arising in Jordan is taxable whoever earns it; a natural person is resident after at least 183 days in Jordan in the tax period (continuous or not), and Jordanian government employees are resident wherever they work. Non-resident Jordanians may claim the exemption for dependants resident in Jordan
